notes: kb/Work PB5925 (listing step 4a of docs/rearchitecture/DESIGN-listing.md, 2026-11-18). §2023:7.3.18.3 GR4: "If OFF is specified, source lines shall not be listed until a LISTING directive specifying or implying the ON phrase is encountered, with the exception that another LISTING OFF directive shall be listed." The driver sets the state OFF at the directive (an emitting branch only; a malformed operand changes no state, COBOL1911) and the listing does not list the lines after it until the state is ON again: the witness's two data lines after OFF are in the model, not listed and not printed, and the second OFF is listed. The earlier CONFORMS rested on the signed derivation DRV-GR-7.3.18.3-4 (unpopulatable-antecedent: no listing is produced, A.1 item 117); a listing is now produced on request (cobol --listing at 2002, 2014 and 2023), so the antecedent is populated and the derivation is withdrawn.
